short: Bessel uniqueness under a weight gap

lean.name: CompanionTheory.Lime.BM.UniqGap
lean.plain: Bessel uniqueness under a weight gap
lean.note: Fix the discrete series and the target type $\pi_u$. In the stated gap range, two Bessel maps with the same character are linearly dependent on smooth vectors, so a nonzero map determines the others there up to scalar.
